summary: Tested WorldCup Nexus first MVP. 18/18 backend pytest tests passed (incl. AI predict/simulate/story/rivality via Claude). Frontend critical flows all working: home hero, theme/lang toggles, matches list (12), live match m6 with momentum & stats, AI prediction on m7, 16 team cards, stats/stadiums/timeline pages load, sim-run-btn and riv-run-btn present.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on initial render — chart container needs minHeight or fixed height to avoid layout reflow warnings (cosmetic, charts still render after reflow)

action_items: Optional: give chart ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height to suppress recharts width(-1) warnings
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.py fallback paths are good for resilience; ensure timeouts in production HTTP client to prevent hangs
data.py: m6 timing relies on hours_offset=-1 so status='LIVE' — fine for demo but will eventually slip to FT after enough hours; consider pinning status='LIVE' (already explicit, OK)

server.py: CORS_ORIGINS='*' wildcard combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec — browsers will reject credentialed requests. Use specific origins if credentials are needed, otherwise set allow_credentials=False.
No DB writes for AI/match data — only /notifications writes to Mongo (acceptable for mock MVP)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 18 endpoints including AI (claude-sonnet-4-5). AI endpoints can take 5-15s each. Live match is m6 (NED vs USA), next scheduled is m7 (POR vs JPN). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the public preview URL — use it for any external testing.
